battle.name: 羅馬-塞琉古戰爭
battle.theater: 安納托利亞瑪格尼西亞
battle.brief: 公元前191年秋，羅馬以安條克三世進攻色雷斯為由宣戰，戰端先由愛奧尼亞海上的羅馬分艦隊打開；前189年冬瑪格尼西亞會戰，執政官西庇阿聯同帕加馬王歐曼尼斯破塞琉古方陣與戰象，翌年訂阿帕米亞和約。卡面亞述長矛屬亞述軍的短柄鐵鏃矛，早於本役近千年；當年對陣的是皮魯姆投槍與薩里沙長槍。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是羅馬共和國與塞琉古王國在前191年至前188年之間的直接衝突，交戰重心在愛奧尼亞海與小亞細亞西部。羅馬一方由元老院授權、兩位執政官分別領兵：前191年出任執政官的是盧基烏斯·科爾內利烏斯·西庇阿·阿西亞提庫斯與格奈烏斯·曼利烏斯·武爾索，前190年作戰期間，弟西庇阿接替病故的兄長格奈烏斯·科爾內利烏斯·西庇阿，統兵進入小亞細亞。羅馬的兵源是公民兵團與拉丁盟友提供的盟軍，編制仍是執政官兩軍團加盟軍，再加各地依附羅馬的城邦兵馬。羅馬陣營中分量最重的是帕加馬王歐曼尼斯二世，他提供步兵與騎兵，並在會戰中指揮右翼騎兵；羅德島、馬其頓王菲利普五世與一批希臘城邦，也各自以出兵或保持中立的方式站在塞琉古的對面。塞琉古一方由大王安條克三世執掌，以安條克與阿帕米亞兩座新都為基地，打造馬其頓式方陣軍、鎧甲重騎、非洲象兵與地中海艦隊，軍中傭兵包括加拉太人、色雷斯人、阿拉伯騎兵、克里特與羅德島弓手，以及為數眾多的希臘雇兵。埃托利亞同盟因與安條克結盟而成為塞琉古最重要的歐洲支柱，卻也因此把自己送上羅馬的攻擊名單。整體而言，這是一場以羅馬聯盟體系對塞琉古王國的立國式戰爭，也是羅馬第一次把大軍投放到愛奧尼亞海以外。
countriesEn: This war was a direct clash between the Roman Republic and the Seleucid kingdom between 191 and 188 BC, fought in the Aegean Sea and in western Asia Minor. On the Roman side the Senate authorised two consuls to command separate armies: the consuls of 191 BC were Lucius Cornelius Scipio Asiaticus and Gnaeus Manlius Vulso, and in the campaigning year of 190 BC the younger Scipio took over the army of his elder brother Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio, who had died of illness, and carried the war into Asia Minor. Rome's manpower came from the citizen legions and from the contingents of Latin allies, organised in the traditional way of two consular legions reinforced by allied troops, plus the contingents of the communities that depended on Rome. The heaviest weight in the Roman camp was the king of Pergamon, Eumenes II, who supplied infantry and cavalry and commanded the cavalry of the right wing at the decisive battle; Rhodes, Philip V of Macedon and a number of Greek cities stood on the other side of Antiochus by contributing troops or by keeping their distance. The Seleucid side was commanded by the Great Antiochus, who used the new capitals of Antioch and Apamea as the bases for a Macedonian-style phalanx army, armoured heavy cavalry, African elephants and a Mediterranean fleet, and whose mercenary contingents included Galatians, Thracians, Arab horsemen, Cretan and Rhodian archers and a great many Greek hired soldiers. The Aetolian League, which had allied itself with Antiochus, became the most important European pillar of the Seleucid position, and by that very fact it put itself on Rome's list of targets. Altogether this was a war of state-building fought by a Roman alliance system against the Seleucid kingdom, and the first time Rome had put great armies beyond the Aegean.
people: 安條克三世是這場戰爭的核心人物。他以大王之名重建塞琉古王國的西亞霸權，前192年率軍渡海峽進入歐洲，奪取色雷斯的要地，再攻入希臘本島，企圖把塞琉古的勢力重新推回愛琴海西岸。漢尼拔是他帳下最醒目的顧問：這位前迦太基統帥主張避開羅馬步兵的正面鋒芒，改以海路或阿爾卑斯山迂迴義大利，他的警告在瑪格尼西亞之後被證明為正確。羅馬方面的決策者是執政官西庇阿·阿西亞提庫斯，他主張把海陸兩線的戰事併作一體，在小亞細亞東岸與敵軍主力正面決戰；其兄格奈烏斯·科爾內利烏斯·西庇阿於前190年病逝，未能見證瑪格尼西亞。歐曼尼斯二世是這場戰爭裡最精於算計的盟友：帕加馬在戰前已奪取安納托利亞西部的要地，他提供大軍參戰，卻始終把本國利益放在勝負之前；這位帕加馬王後來以阿塔洛斯二世之名嗣位，並在前133年將整個王國遺贈羅馬。帕加馬王與安條克之間的矛盾隨戰局逆轉而爆發，兩軍在瑪格尼西亞的接觸，幾乎在開戰當天就發展成互相猜忌。塞琉古海軍統帥波呂克塞尼達斯在希俄斯與歐律墨冬兩度與羅馬交手，羅馬分艦隊統帥雷吉盧斯則在科里庫斯取勝、又在歐律墨冬受挫。此外，溫泉關之戰中被安條克夜襲的羅馬營地裡，還有加圖這位日後以嚴厲著稱的羅馬將領，他靠游泳才逃出生天。安條克三世本人於前189年在瑪格尼西亞的一座神廟中被祭司刺殺，起因是他未能補償被埃托利亞人劫掠的神廟。
peopleEn: The central figure was Antiochus III, the Great. He had rebuilt Seleucid predominance in the west of Asia under the title of the Great, and in 192 BC he crossed the straits with his army, seized the key positions of Thrace and then drove into the Greek mainland, hoping to push Seleucid power back to the western shore of the Aegean. The most conspicuous counsellor in his camp was Hannibal: the former Carthaginian commander urged him to avoid the frontal edge of the Roman infantry and to carry the war around to Italy by sea or over the Alps, and his warning was vindicated after Magnesia. The decision-maker on the Roman side was the consul Scipio Asiaticus, who argued for joining the naval and the land campaigns into a single operation and for meeting the main Seleucid army in a set-piece battle on the eastern side of Asia Minor; his brother Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio died of illness in 190 BC and did not live to see Magnesia. Eumenes II was the most calculating ally in the war: Pergamon had already taken the important cities of western Anatolia before the campaign, he brought a large army to the field, and he never let the interest of his own kingdom fall behind the result; this king of Pergamon later succeeded to the throne under the name Attalus II and in 133 BC bequeathed his whole kingdom to Rome. The friction between the king of Pergamon and Antiochus broke out as soon as the fortunes of the war turned, and the contact between the two armies at Magnesia turned into mutual suspicion almost on the day it began. On the Seleucid side Polyxenidas commanded the fleet and met Rome twice, at Chios and at the Eurymedon; Regillus, who led the Roman squadron, won at Corycus and was then beaten at the Eurymedon. In the Roman camp at Thermopylae, which Antiochus stormed by night, was also Cato, the Roman officer later famous for his severity, who escaped only by swimming. Antiochus III himself was killed by a priest in a temple at Magnesia in 189 BC, the motive for the killing being his failure to make recompense for a temple the Aetolians had plundered.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長矛屬於新亞述帝國的武器譜系：短柄、長刃、鐵鏃，是九至七世紀兩河流域用來守城與野戰的近身兵器，亞述人把它與弓及鐵器配合使用，車兵居中、步兵列於側翼。距本役約九百餘年，這種短柄鐵鏃矛在希臘化世界的軍械庫裡早已不見蹤影，191年的戰場上真正握在士兵手上的長兵器是另外兩種：羅馬的皮魯姆與塞琉古方陣的薩里沙。皮魯姆是羅馬步卒最倚重的投射兵器，木柄長約兩米，前段接一段鐵製矛幹，擲出後可插入盾牌或黏在盾牌與手臂上，迫使敵人放下武器；近身則以短劍配合弧形大盾。塞琉古方陣的薩里沙是更長的希臘式刺槍，槍身長約五至六米，槍葉窄長，須雙手推送，十六排密集縱深列陣，專為承受衝鋒而設計。馬其頓傳統的守護者如銀盾護士使用較短的武器與大圓盾，配合方陣擔任後排。塞琉古騎兵中包含披重鎧的卡塔法克特，鎧甲連人帶馬，以長矛作主要刺擊武器；輕騎則與阿拉伯馬、克里特弓手配合，負責側翼騷擾。攻城方面，羅馬人帶著攻城塔、撞槌、雲梯與弩炮，塞琉古守軍以高牆、塔樓與投射兵器應戰。海戰雙方用三列槳戰列艦與帶撞角的輕舟，攻方另備可折疊的攻城塔。卡面長矛在本役的真正位置，是「方陣長矛」這一戰術角色的象徵：亞述人靠短矛與弓箭結合成列，塞琉古靠薩里沙與方陣縱深結合成列，兩者都代表以刺槍正面承壓、拒止騎兵的同一種軍事邏輯。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to the weapon family of the Neo-Assyrian empire: a short shaft, a long blade and an iron head, the close-combat arm of the armies of the Mesopotamian riverlands in the ninth to seventh centuries BC, which the Assyrians combined with the bow and with the iron of their arsenal, chariots in the centre and infantry drawn up in echelon on the flanks. Some nine hundred years separate it from this campaign, and a short iron-tipped spear of that kind had long since disappeared from the arsenals of the Hellenistic world; the long weapons actually in the soldiers' hands in 191 BC were two others. The pilum was the Roman infantryman's most trusted missile, a wooden shaft about two metres long with a forged iron shank at the front, which, once thrown, would stick in a shield or in shield and arm together and force the enemy to drop his weapon; at close quarters the Roman used the short sword together with the curved scutum. The sarissa of the Seleucid phalanx was the longer Greek thrusting pike, a shaft of some five to six metres with a long narrow blade, pushed with both hands, sixteen files deep, designed above all to receive the shock of a charge. Macedonian tradition's guards, the Silver Shields, used shorter weapons and a large round shield and formed the rear of the phalanx. The Seleucid cavalry included cataphracts armoured in mail on horse and rider alike, using the long lance as their principal arm, while light horse and Cretan archers worked in combination to harass the flanks. In siege operations the Romans brought towers, rams, scaling ladders and bolt-shooting artillery, and the Seleucid defenders answered from high walls and towers with missile weapons. At sea both sides used triremes and ram-equipped light vessels, the attackers adding folding siege towers. The place of the card's spear in this campaign is properly the symbol of the tactical role of the phalanx pike: the Assyrians formed their battle line out of short spears and bows, the Seleucid out of sarissas and the depth of the phalanx, and both express the same military logic of meeting a charge frontally with thrusting spears and refusing cavalry.
tactics: 瑪格尼西亞會戰是本役的定盤星，戰術細節以波利比奧斯的目擊記錄最為完整。塞琉古的佈置是典型的安條克式：以方陣放在左翼，由重騎與象兵在前方及右翼護衛，企圖以方陣的衝擊直接壓垮羅馬正面，馬其頓傳統的做法是方陣不求靈活、只求在接觸面上保持厚度，安條克把總兵力集中於一翼，正是打算以左翼的突破帶動全軍。羅馬方面，執政官西庇阿把三線縱深陣擺成彈性接觸線：最前是攜投槍的輕矛兵，其後是主力步兵，再後是第三線預備隊，兩翼各有騎兵遮護；他把右翼向後拉開，利用地形讓帕加馬騎兵（由歐曼尼斯二世率領）繞過塞琉古方陣的側背，縱隊拉得越長，迂迴打擊的效力越大。交戰時塞琉古方陣以雷霆之勢壓向前線，羅馬前線在衝擊下退卻數步卻沒有崩潰，得以維持陣線；方陣衝進羅馬陣中後無法展開，側翼又被羅馬與帕加馬騎兵切斷，縱深被縱向折疊，戰局就此逆轉。象兵在此役幾乎毫無作用：象群在混戰中找不到目標，反而衝散己方步卒，羅馬輕矛兵以投射兵器對付象夫與象腿，才把它們逐漸引開。戰役的勝負並非全靠正面：羅馬在整場戰爭中還把聯盟與封鎖當作武器——前191年在愛奧尼亞海以海戰先勝，斷安條克的海上補給；前190年聯手帕加馬在米俄涅索斯再勝，海軍封鎖使塞琉古無法從腓尼基與塞浦路斯運兵；前190年安條克夜襲溫泉關的羅馬營雖得手，卻未能改變希臘的均勢，反而把埃托利亞同盟推向絕境。羅軍的補給多由海路解決，遠征線拉得越長，海運壓力越大，這也是西庇阿堅持速戰速決的原因。
tacticsEn: The battle of Magnesia was the decisive engagement of the war, and the tactical details survive most completely in the eyewitness account of Polybius. The Seleucid deployment was characteristically Antiochid: the phalanx was posted on the left, covered in front and on the right by heavy cavalry and elephants, with the intention of breaking the Roman front directly with the shock of the pike, in the Macedonian manner where the phalanx asks for no mobility but only for thickness at the point of contact; Antiochus concentrated his strength on one wing precisely in order to carry the whole line with a breakthrough on the left. The Romans, under the consul Scipio, drew up the triplex acies as an elastic line of contact: light-armed men with javelins in front, the main body of infantry behind them and a third line of reserves further back, with cavalry covering both wings; he extended the right wing so as to use the ground and let the Pergamene cavalry under Eumenes II ride round the flank and the rear of the Seleucid phalanx, on the principle that the longer the column the greater the effect of the turning movement. When the phalanx came on with the force of a thunderstorm the Roman front gave ground for a few paces but did not break, and so the line was held; the phalanx, having pushed into the Roman line, could not deploy, its flank was cut by the Roman and Pergamene horse, its depth was folded back on itself, and the battle was decided. The elephants did almost nothing: in the mêlée they had no target and scattered the Seleucid infantry instead, and it was only by shooting at the drivers and at the legs of the animals with missiles that the Romans gradually drew them away. The outcome was not settled by the frontal clash alone. Rome fought the whole war with alliances and blockade as weapons: a naval victory in the Aegean in 191 BC struck at Antiochus's sea supply, and in 190 BC a combined Roman and Pergamene fleet won at Myonessus, after which the blockade kept the Seleucid army from drawing troops from Phoenicia and Cyprus. Antiochus's night attack on the Roman camp at Thermopylae in 190 BC did indeed succeed, but it did not alter the balance in Greece; instead it drove the Aetolian League to desperation. Much of the Roman supply came by sea, and the longer the line of operations the heavier the burden of the sea transport, which was why Scipio pressed for a decision.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。戰爭自前191年羅馬宣戰起，至前188年訂立阿帕米亞和約止，曆時約四年，實際野外作戰集中在前191至前189年。瑪格尼西亞會戰通常繫於前189年1月，地點在小亞細亞西部瑪格尼西亞城外的西庇流斯山麓，離帕加馬城約六十餘公里，羅馬軍隊自義大利南部登船渡亞得里亞海，再由海路與陸路分別運兵運糧。兵員方面，波利比奧斯記載安條克集結的兵力在八萬上下、騎兵約一萬五千，另備戰象約十五頭；羅馬與帕加馬聯軍的步兵約四萬至五萬，其中帕加馬方出動約二萬步卒與五千騎兵，羅馬與盟軍騎兵合計近萬。戰後官方戰報稱羅馬軍陣亡約二千，塞琉古軍陣亡與被俘合計逾萬，這類數字多出自各方誇大，只能當量級看待。損失最重的不是人命而是裝備：塞琉古在和約中交出絕大部分戰象，艦隊只准保留十數艘小艇，並賠付一萬五千塔蘭特白銀，分期交付並以人質作保；羅馬則承認帕加馬在小亞細亞的擴張，羅德島取得卡里亞與呂基亞，羅馬直接取得馬格尼西亞與弗里吉亞，並得到塞琉古在亞洲遵奉同一套「朋友與敵人」名單的條款。前191年科里庫斯海戰中，羅馬分艦隊擊毀塞琉古大批三列槳船，使安條克原計畫以海軍支援小亞細亞陸軍的方案失效。戰役的時間成本同樣可計：從羅馬宣戰到瑪格尼西亞決戰約兩年，決戰到和約又近一年。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The war runs from the Roman declaration in 191 BC to the Treaty of Apamea in 188 BC, a matter of some four years, with the field fighting concentrated between 191 and 189 BC. The battle of Magnesia is usually dated to January 189 BC, on the lower slopes of Mount Sipylus outside the city of Magnesia in western Asia Minor, some sixty odd kilometres from the city of Pergamon; the Roman troops sailed from southern Italy, crossed the Adriatic, and were then moved and provisioned by sea and by land. As for numbers, Polybius records Antiochus's force at something like eighty thousand foot, about fifteen thousand horse and a further fifteen war elephants; the Roman and Pergamene infantry numbered between forty and fifty thousand, of which Pergamon supplied about twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse, while the Roman and allied horse together came to close on ten thousand. The official reports after the battle put Roman dead at about two thousand and Seleucid dead and captured at more than ten thousand, figures inflated on both sides and good only as an order of magnitude. The heaviest losses were not in lives but in material: the Seleucid gave up the bulk of their elephants, were allowed to keep only a dozen or so small vessels, and agreed to pay fifteen thousand talents of silver in instalments with hostages given as security; Rome on its side recognised the Pergamene expansion in Asia Minor, gave Caria and Lycia to Rhodes, took Magnesia and the two Phrygias directly, and obtained a clause in which the Seleucid undertook to treat as friends and enemies the same persons as Rome. At the Battle of Corycus in 191 BC the Roman squadron destroyed a large part of the Seleucid triremes and killed Antiochus's plan of supporting his army in Asia Minor by sea. The cost in time can be counted as well: about two years from the Roman declaration to the decision at Magnesia, and nearly a further year from the decision to the peace.
cause: 導火線是安條克三世渡海進入歐洲。前192年他率軍渡海峽，奪取色雷斯的埃涅斯與拉里薩等要地，再進兵希臘本島，包圍埃托利亞同盟的城市。埃托利亞人向羅馬求援，羅馬先派出三名使節到安條克面前交涉，要求他撤出歐洲、歸還所奪城市、停止攻擊自由城邦；安條克接待使節時態度倨傲，不肯讓步，反過來要求羅馬放棄在希臘的解放主張。前191年，羅馬元老院據此宣戰，公開理由是安條克包圍羅馬控制的埃涅斯、並奴役亞洲的自由城邦。往深一層看，這場戰爭是希臘化世界力量對比改變的必然結果。塞琉古在第二次馬其頓戰爭中擊敗菲利普五世，重新取得小亞細亞與安條克的霸權，國勢恢復的安條克三世不會接受羅馬以解放希臘為名插手亞洲；而羅馬在第二次布匿戰爭以及西西里與西班牙的征服之後，國力、海軍與遠征經驗都足以把戰場推到愛奧尼亞海。帕加馬與羅德島願意出兵，正是因為它們害怕塞琉古重新統一小亞細亞；而安條克若在此役得勝，羅馬的盟邦將逐一被拆散。因此這場戰爭的實質，是新生的地中海強權與正在恢復的舊霸權之間，圍繞小亞細亞歸屬的一場對撞；埃托利亞同盟的求援，只是讓它提前爆發。
causeEn: The spark was Antiochus III's entry into Europe. In 192 BC he crossed the straits with his army, took the key positions of Thrace such as Aenus and Larissa, and then drove into the Greek mainland, where he besieged the cities of the Aetolian League. The Aetolians appealed to Rome, and Rome first sent three envoys to Antiochus with the demand that he withdraw from Europe, restore what he had taken, and stop attacking the free cities; Antiochus received them with a show of arrogance, refused to give way, and turned the demand back on Rome, telling it to abandon its pretensions of liberating Greece. In 191 BC the Roman Senate declared war on those grounds, the public reasons being that Antiochus was besieging Aenus, which Rome held, and was enslaving the free cities of Asia. At a deeper level the war was the necessary result of a change in the balance of power in the Hellenistic world. Having beaten Philip V in the Second Macedonian War, the Seleucid kingdom had recovered its mastery of Asia Minor and of Antioch, and a recovered Antiochus III would not accept Rome's interference in Asia under the banner of the liberation of Greece; and Rome, having finished the Second Punic War and the conquests in Sicily and Spain, possessed the money, the fleet and the experience of long-range campaigning needed to carry the war to the Aegean. Pergamon and Rhodes were willing to provide troops precisely because they feared a Seleucid restoration of unity in Asia Minor; and had Antiochus won, Rome's client states would have been picked off one by one. The substance of the war, therefore, was a collision between a new Mediterranean power and an old empire in recovery over the ownership of Asia Minor, and the appeal of the Aetolian League merely brought it into the open early.
impact: 阿帕米亞和約之後，希臘化世界的版圖被重新劃定。塞琉古王國退守敘利亞與美索不達米亞，淪為羅馬認定友好的附庸，向外擴張的能力幾乎被徹底封死；小亞細亞的富庶城邦被分給帕加馬、羅德島與羅馬，羅馬則以「朋友與敵人」的名義取得了直接干預亞洲的依據。此戰之後，帕加馬王國升格為小亞細亞第一強國，歐曼尼斯二世於前138年嗣位為阿塔洛斯二世，前133年病逝時將王位與國土遺贈羅馬，亞細亞行省由此而生——這條從瑪格尼西亞通往繼承的線，是羅馬由地中海共和國走向亞洲統治者的關鍵一步。羅馬的海外形象也重塑：它不再只是解放者，而是仲裁者。溫泉關前夜襲得手、瑪格尼西亞的正面會戰、以及隨後羅馬掉頭攻擊埃托利亞同盟，都顯示羅馬可以在遠離本土之地連續作戰，而不必依賴單一盟友。希臘城邦的自主空間被進一步壓縮，埃托利亞同盟在受創後再無力與羅馬抗衡。留下的長遠後果，是羅馬在希臘化東方的霸權、亞細亞行省的設立，以及此後一個世紀羅馬對亞洲的直接介入；羅馬軍中帶回的戰利品與塞琉古交的賠款，也讓共和國的財政與將領的政治資本為之一變。至於塞琉古王國，它雖未被毀，卻從此淪為次一等強國，困守敘利亞與美索不達米亞，其後的兄弟爭位與王位更迭，都只能在羅馬認可的框架內進行。
impactEn: After the Treaty of Apamea the map of the Hellenistic world was redrawn. The Seleucid kingdom withdrew to Syria and Mesopotamia, became a client of Rome recognised as a friend, and lost almost all power of expansion; the wealthy cities of Asia Minor were divided among Pergamon, Rhodes and Rome, and Rome obtained a standing pretext for direct intervention in Asia. After the war the kingdom of Pergamon rose to be the leading power of Asia Minor; Eumenes II succeeded to the throne as Attalus II in 138 BC and, dying in 133 BC, left his kingdom and his title to Rome, and the province of Asia was created out of that bequest — the line that runs from Magnesia to that inheritance is the key step by which Rome passed from a Mediterranean republic into a ruler of Asia. Rome's image in the outside world was remade as well: it was no longer only the liberator but the arbiter. The night attack at Thermopylae, the set-piece battle at Magnesia and the subsequent turn of Rome's arms against the Aetolian League all show that Rome could campaign repeatedly far from home without having to depend on a single ally. The room for autonomy left to the Greek cities narrowed further, and the Aetolian League, once wounded, was in no position to stand against Rome. The lasting consequence was a Roman hegemony over the Hellenistic East, the making of the Roman province of Asia, and the opening of a century of direct Roman intervention in Asia; the booty brought back by the Roman troops and the indemnity paid by the Seleucid also altered the finances of the Republic and the political capital of its commanders. As for the Seleucid kingdom, it was not destroyed, but from that point it became a second-rate power shut up in Syria and Mesopotamia, and the fraternal quarrels and changes of ruler that followed could henceforth take place only inside the framework Rome recognised.
result: 本役的結局是一場徹底的羅馬勝利。瑪格尼西亞會戰中，塞琉古方陣被縱向折疊，國王安條克三世拋下營帳乘馬逃往薩爾迪斯，親兵與象兵多被殺傷或衝散，被俘者以千計，聯軍主力崩潰；安條克回到安條克城後，只能靠海路維持殘局，而他的艦隊早已在戰爭中損失殆盡。他於前189年在瑪格尼西亞的一座神廟中被祭司刺殺，結束了自己的政治生涯。羅馬人沒有追入敘利亞：元老院下令軍隊止於陶魯斯山脈，只接受安條克提出的折衷方案，即高額賠款與歸還爭議中的亞洲領土。最終的結算是前188年的阿帕米亞和約，安條克三世交出亞洲屬地，賠付一萬五千塔蘭特，繳出戰象與絕大部分艦隊，並接受「羅馬人民之友」的公開地位。直接結果是塞琉古王國淪為困守敘利亞與美索不達米亞的次等強權，愛奧尼亞海與小亞細亞落入帕加馬、羅德島與羅馬手中；長遠結果則是羅馬在希臘化東方的霸權、亞細亞行省的設立，以及羅馬介入亞洲長達一個世紀的開端。前191年開打的那場戰爭，同時也證明了漢尼拔的戰略無法成立：塞琉古的軍隊雖然數量龐大，卻無法被帶到自己選定的戰場與羅馬軍團交鋒，而一旦被引入小亞細亞並遭擊敗，那條原本可以把戰火帶回義大利的海路就徹底消失了。
resultEn: The outcome of the campaign was a complete Roman victory. At Magnesia the Seleucid phalanx was folded back on itself, the king Antiochus III left his camp and rode away to Sardis, most of his guard and his elephants were killed or scattered, thousands of his men were taken prisoner, and the heart of his army was broken. Returning to Antioch, Antiochus could only hold what was left by sea, and his fleet had already been lost in the course of the war. In 189 BC he was killed by a priest in a temple at Magnesia, which ended his political career. The Romans did not march into Syria: the Senate ordered the army to stop at the range of the Taurus and took only the compromise Antiochus offered, namely a large indemnity and the surrender of the disputed Asian territories. The final settlement was the Treaty of Apamea in 188 BC, by which Antiochus III ceded his Asian possessions, agreed to pay fifteen thousand talents, gave up his elephants and the bulk of his fleet, and accepted the public standing of a friend of the Roman people. The immediate result was that the Seleucid kingdom became a second-rate power shut up in Syria and Mesopotamia, while the Aegean and Asia Minor passed to Pergamon, to Rhodes and to Rome; the lasting result was Roman hegemony over the Hellenistic East, the making of the province of Asia, and the opening of a century of Roman intervention in Asia. The war that began in 191 BC also showed that Hannibal's strategy could not work: the Seleucid host, though great in numbers, could not be brought to battle the Roman legions on ground of its own choosing, and once it had been drawn into Asia Minor and beaten, the sea route that would have carried the war to Italy was gone for good.
